about: Bata India Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in footwear and accessories through its retail and wholesale network in India and internationally. It offers men's footwear, including casual shoes, slippers and flipflops, as well as ethnic, formal, loafers, sandals, sneakers, sports, and outdoor shoes.
